visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with brown hair and glasses, wearing a cream-colored vest over a white long-sleeved shirt, sits in a bright, modern clinic office. She looks directly at the camera with an energetic facial expression, gesturing with her hands as she speaks. Behind her is a white shelf holding a luxury handbag and framed certificates. Yellow text overlays appear on the screen. (2) Graphic animations of shining gold coins begin to fall and shower over the woman from the top of the frame. She continues to smile and talk while the coins overlay the scene. (3) The woman gestures 'no' by crossing her arms in front of her chest and then moving her hands outward in a sweeping motion. Multiple yellow text captions appear around her hands to emphasize her point. (4) A special effect is applied where bright yellow light beams shoot out from the woman's eyes. She remains seated and speaks with a playful yet serious intensity. (5) The woman leans forward slightly, continuing her explanation with fluid hand movements. The camera remains at an eye-level medium close-up shot throughout the segment. (6) The woman points both index fingers toward the camera in a confident gesture, followed by forming a heart shape with her fingers. Bright sparkles and heart icons appear on the screen. (7) The video transitions to a clean white screen containing the clinic logo, social media handles, and contact phone numbers in a centered layout.
